title: Mission
description: Centred intro with photo cards, each labelled over the photo and described underneath

text.default: GYC exists to equip the next generation to be missionaries for Christ wherever life takes them.

default.title: Service
default.text: Serving communities across Europe with love, humility, and practical action — reflecting Christ in every context.

default.title: Evangelism
default.text: Equipping young people to share the three angels' messages boldly and faithfully in their cities and campuses.

default.title: Biblical studies
default.text: Deepening knowledge of Scripture through seminars, workshops, and mentorship with gifted Bible teachers.

default.title: Congresses
default.text: Gathering hundreds of young Europeans each year for days of worship, community, training, and inspiration.
